content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. Let me actually say what I mean.

A morning like that, no phone, water, feeling hopeful again after months of running on empty, that's not nothing. That's the version of you that's been missing for a while showing back up.

And telling your team you needed a real break, then actually taking it, two weeks starting Monday. That's you choosing yourself after a long stretch of not having room to. Happy birthday, Lena. I hope those two weeks give you back more of that feeling from this morning."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
